text:
Anita Shah: Heads up — my PR chain for the telemetry change touches sdk, api, and console. Need approvals + merge sequencing. PRs: sdk#412, api#889, console#210, plus a small helm values update. Anyone blocking?

Mike L.: I can review sdk#412 today. CI needs to be green (unit + e2e) before I approve.

Carmen O'Neill: api#889 depends on the proto change in sdk#412 — I'm blocked on that. Sequence should be sdk -> api -> console -> helm, IMO.

Raj Patel: We should avoid parallel merges into main. Suggest a 30-min window tomorrow 11:30–12:00 PT to stitch these. @Anita does that work?

Anita Shah: Works for me. Plan: merge sdk, wait ~5m for canary, then api, run quick staging checks, then console + helm. I'll queue a canary job after sdk merges and run `make smoke-local` for a sanity check.

Olivia Chen: Console owner here — I'll approve console#210 after api#889 is merged and staging looks good. Heads-up: console e2e has had an intermittent auth flake; I'll be standing by to fix fast if it pops.

Mike L.: CI is green for sdk right now but we had a gpu-mock flake yesterday. Re-triggering the pipeline to be safe. @deploy-bot can you hold off any auto-merge until someone manual-acks?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Auto-merge paused for PR chain tag `dep-chain/telemetry` — manual merge required.

Carmen O'Neill: After sdk is merged I'll kick off the integration tests in staging and post logs here if anything fails.

Raj Patel: OK schedule confirmed: tomorrow 11:30 PT start sdk merge, wait 5m for canary, then api merge + 10m staging smoke, then console + helm. Rollback plan: revert sdk commit and notify infra if we see regression.

Anita Shah: :thumbsup: I'll also open a tiny follow-up PR to tweak helm values if the canary shows mismatched resource requests.

Mike L.: Approving sdk#412 now. Anita — ping me right after merge and I'll cut the api canary release.

Olivia Chen: Noted — I'll monitor staging and call out the auth flake immediately if it appears.

Carmen O'Neill: Thanks all. I'll add a short checklist to each PR: [sdk unit], [api integration], [console e2e], [helm lint] so we can tick things off during the window.
